create_FootStepper: create a FootStepper instance with a bullet client, toe IDs, and local reference toe positions
update_FootStepper: update the FootStepper state machine with a StepInput to compute new toe world positions
next_foot_FootStepper: advance the swing foot index to the next foot in the quadruped gait sequence
swing_foot_FootStepper: activate the swing foot movement flag to begin moving the current swing foot to its target
is_com_stable_FootStepper: check if the robot center of mass is stable by evaluating yaw and distance thresholds
